skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the functions and operations of central banks in monetary policy.
Understand the operations of central banks in issuing currency and credit.
Analyze the open market operations and foreign exchange management of central banks.
Understand the supervision and inspection activities of central banks.
Analyze the economic functions and roles of central banks.
Develop independent thinking and critical analysis skills in studying central banks.
Work effectively in groups to complete assignments and projects.
Develop skills to present before an audience.
Understand and comply with legal and regulatory requirements of central banks.
Maintain a commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
